opportunities.name: Buckler return trade
opportunities.objective: Combine a ranged buckler attack with a shield pickup before reentry.
opportunities.mechanic: The passive attack gains range and a recoverable health-scaled shield. Trinity rewards a preceding cast, Dead Man's discharges on an attack and Sundered Sky tests the first champion attack heal. Visage strengthens recovered shielding/healing; E wall collision can buy pickup time.
opportunities.requiredState: Passive ready, spell cast before buckler and an accessible landing point.
opportunities.failure: The opponent destroys the buckler or terrain access costs more health than the shield grants.
opportunities.test: Separate buckler attack, item packets and pickup shield while comparing pickup versus forfeiture.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: A ranged buckler attack does not make every Poppy spell an on-hit carrier.

opportunities.name: Dash gate magic
opportunities.objective: Concentrate budget on punishing dash attempts through W.
opportunities.mechanic: W's anti-dash hit has 0.7 AP, while E wall stun or tap R can keep a victim near Abyssal and Zeke. Cosmic reacts to W/passive magic damage; AP improves W without raising Q's percent-health physical term. The route depends on enemies choosing a dash inside W.
opportunities.requiredState: Enemy dash available, W field correctly timed and tap R used for local contact.
opportunities.failure: Enemies walk away or hold mobility; charged R removes them from the damage zone.
opportunities.test: Compare dash-stop damage and aura contact with tap versus charged R against a scripted dash.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: More AP does not cause W to hit enemies who never dash.

ruledOut.reason: Charged R makes flying targets untargetable; local attacks cannot continue normally.

unknowns: W resistance Stat terms and Q slow raw-stat expression require validation; buckler item delivery must be logged.

builds.name: Buckler return trade
builds.summary: Combine a ranged buckler attack with a shield pickup before reentry.
builds.goal: Combine a ranged buckler attack with a shield pickup before reentry.
builds.hypothesis: The passive attack gains range and a recoverable health-scaled shield. Trinity rewards a preceding cast, Dead Man's discharges on an attack and Sundered Sky tests the first champion attack heal. Visage strengthens recovered shielding/healing; E wall collision can buy pickup time.
testPlan: Required state: Passive ready, spell cast before buckler and an accessible landing point.
Separate buckler attack, item packets and pickup shield while comparing pickup versus forfeiture.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: The opponent destroys the buckler or terrain access costs more health than the shield grants.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: A ranged buckler attack does not make every Poppy spell an on-hit carrier.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Trinity Force, Dead Man's Plate, Sundered Sky, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Poppy gains [(0.16) × Stat(1)] Armor and [(0.16) × Stat(6)] Magic Resist. This bonus is doubled if Poppy is below [40]% Health.

Active: Poppy gains [40]% Move Speed and projects a field around her for [2] seconds that stops enemy dashes. Enemies who are stopped by the field are Grounded and Slowed by [25]% for [2] seconds and take [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage.

Every [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=16, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -4.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 19, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -2.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds, Poppy's next Attack throws her buckler, gaining [350] range and dealing an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(20 → 180; raw flags preserved)] magic damage. The buckler ricochets off the target, landing nearby. Poppy can pick it up to gain [(characterLevelInterpolation(0.11 → 0.2; raw flags preserved)) × Stat(12)] Shield, and enemies can step on it to destroy it.

The buckler automatically returns to Poppy if it kills the target.

Poppy tackles an enemy, dealing [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and carrying them forward. If Poppy tackles them into terrain, the enemy is Stunned for [1.6 / 1.7 / 1.8 / 1.9 / 2] seconds and take an additional [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.
